More specifically, it is calculated as the first Sunday after the Paschal Full Moon (the first full moon occurring on or after the vernal equinox) and can fall anywhere between March 20 and April 23 in terms of calendar dates. In the Northern Hemisphere, this usually corresponds to the vernal (spring) equinox, which occurs around March 20-21.
